database: SQLite; database/doodle.sqlite is created by install.php and must not be committed
web_command: php -d session.save_path=tmp/sessions -d upload_tmp_dir=tmp/uploads -d upload_max_filesize=10M -d post_max_size=12M -S 127.0.0.1:8173 -t . router.local.php
notes: Run from the repository root after creating tmp/sessions and tmp/uploads.
No Composer, npm, Node, MySQL or cloud account is needed for the current baseline.
Upstream views request Google Fonts/icons; full offline visual fidelity has not been verified.
Other PHP versions, MySQL and other operating systems have not been runtime-tested.
Live scanning requires cURL, a trusted CA store and a personal VirusTotal key. Fixture mode performs no provider requests.
optional_javascript_check: node tests/flashcard-study.test.cjs (Node standard library only; not required to run the LMS)
